Getting Started

Component Library

Core Feature

Components

Flutcom's component engine allows you to inject raw HTML templates with dynamic JSON props. No Virtual DOM, no compilation. Just pure, blazing fast text replacement.

Components are plain .html files with {{ prop }} placeholders. They are resolved at render time and cached in memory — meaning the second usage is completely free.

Fully Reusable

Write once, use anywhere with different props each time.

In-Memory Cache

Templates are fetched once and reused at zero network cost.

JSON Props

Pass any data as strictly valid JSON through fc-props.

Props API

How to pass and render variables inside any component.

View HTML (sender)
<div
  fc-component="resources/components/card.html"
  fc-props='{
    "title": "My Card",
    "description": "A great card.",
    "icon": "bi bi-star"
  }'>
</div>
card.html (receiver)
<div class="p-6 rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
  <i class="{{ icon }}"></i>
  <h3>{{ title }}</h3>
  <p>{{ description }}</p>
</div>

Strict JSON Required

The value of fc-props must be strictly valid JSON. No trailing commas, use double quotes for keys and string values, and escape any special characters.

Alert Component

Useful for displaying important messages, warnings, or tips throughout your app.

Usage
<div fc-component="resources/components/alert.html"
     fc-props='{
       "icon": "bi bi-info-circle text-blue-400",
       "title": "Did you know?",
       "description": "Your message here."
     }'></div>

Badge Component

Compact status indicators and label tags — style them freely via the classes prop.

Usage
<div fc-component="resources/components/badge.html"
     fc-props='{
       "icon": "bi bi-check-circle-fill",
       "text": "Stable",
       "classes": "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20"
     }'></div>

Button Component

Pass Tailwind classes via classes prop to create any variant — primary, destructive, social, and more.

Usage
<div fc-component="resources/components/button.html"
     fc-props='{
       "icon": "bi bi-rocket-takeoff",
       "text": "Deploy Now",
       "classes": "bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200"
     }'></div>

Feature Cards

Rich card components for showcasing features, services, or any content block with icon, title, and description.

Usage
<div fc-component="resources/components/feature-card.html"
     fc-props='{
       "icon": "bi bi-lightning-charge text-purple-400",
       "accent": "bg-purple-500/10",
       "title": "Your Feature",
       "description": "A short description of what this feature does."
     }'></div>

Nesting Components

You can place multiple fc-component tags anywhere in a view — including inside loops or grids — and Flutcom will resolve them all in parallel.

example: feature grid
<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">

  <div fc-component="resources/components/card.html"
       fc-props='{"title": "Speed", "icon": "bi bi-lightning"}'></div>

  <div fc-component="resources/components/card.html"
       fc-props='{"title": "Simplicity", "icon": "bi bi-feather"}'></div>

  <div fc-component="resources/components/card.html"
       fc-props='{"title": "Power", "icon": "bi bi-cpu"}'></div>

</div>

All fc-component elements on a page are resolved concurrently using Promise.all — so even if you nest dozens of components, there's no waterfall delay.

Creating Custom Components

Any .html file in your project can be a component. Here's how to build one from scratch.

1 Create the template file
<!-- resources/components/stat-card.html -->
<div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900 border border-white/5">
  <div class="text-3xl font-black text-white">{{ value }}</div>
  <div class="text-sm text-zinc-500 mt-1">{{ label }}</div>
</div>
2 Use it in any view
<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
  <div fc-component="resources/components/stat-card.html"
       fc-props='{"value": "4KB", "label": "Bundle Size"}'></div>
  <div fc-component="resources/components/stat-card.html"
       fc-props='{"value": "0ms", "label": "Nav Time"}'></div>
  <div fc-component="resources/components/stat-card.html"
       fc-props='{"value": "Zero", "label": "Dependencies"}'></div>
</div>
